//: Configuration for a Tiny Tapeout micro tile on sky130A.
The die area, pin template, top routing layer (met3) and the PDN layers (met2 and met3)
are set by tt-support-tools for `tiles: micro` and override anything set here.
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
Power, vertical: a VPWR/VGND pair of met2 stripes at each end of the core ties the met1
rails together. The stripes are centered between met2 tracks, so each blocks two tracks.
Power, horizontal: four met3 stripes, VPWR and VGND alternating every four rows, centered
between met3 tracks. The container project connects its vertical met4 stripes to them
with via3, wherever they cross.
No power rings
Save some time
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs
Reduce wasted space
Absolute die size
Clock
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS may cause issues with LVS
Only export pin area in LEF (without any connected nets)
